entities.name: Teimuraz II of Kakheti
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Teimuraz II (1695–1762) of the Bagrationi dynasty, was a king (mepe) of Kakheti, eastern Georgia, from 1732 to 1744, then of Kartli from 1744 until his death. Teimuraz was also a lyric poet.
